physical_justifications.lambda_turnover: Base penalty for switching team possession. At 25 fps, equivalent to ~0.5s of strong contradictory evidence.
physical_justifications.lambda_stoppage: Base penalty for transitioning to Dead Ball (D), modulated by ball visibility and Smart Tagging set-piece windows.
physical_justifications.lambda_restart: Base penalty for transitioning from Dead Ball to Live Play, modulated by ball presence and active player touch.
physical_justifications.min_sustained_frames: 12 frames (0.48s). Fleeting micro-islands shorter than this without sustained carrier support are regularized.
physical_justifications.evidence_weight: Weight of physical control evidence scores (score_h, score_a) in emission cost modulation.
physical_justifications.v2_prior_cost: Baseline penalty when proposed state disagrees with grounded v2 candidate.
physical_justifications.carrier_dead_ball_penalty: Penalty forbidding Dead Ball declaration when a player is actively dribbling the ball.
